project.name: Acton Bridge Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 1 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 6 of 6 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town
touristAppeal.summary: Acton Bridge has recorded local interest, but its current in-boundary visitor offer does not meet the threshold for a tourist-town rating.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Acton Bridge
townGuide.intro: Acton Bridge has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Acton Bridge centre
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Use the map to understand the settlement and its currently curated public facilities.

townGuide.suggestedTime: As part of a wider local journey
townGuide.visitorMood: A local settlement rather than a tourist destination.

townStudyArea.sourceName: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
townStudyArea.notes: The original ONS built-up area is preserved. The active visitor boundary additionally includes only directly adjoining mapped public green spaces: OSM way 333945211.
